metadata.title: ZYQL: A Trivalent-Decision Quantum Language with Pre-Registered, Signed Evidence Receipts (v1.0)
metadata.description: Artifact release for the ZYQL quantum language (v1.3): formal EBNF grammar (ISO/IEC 14977) with operational semantics, C kernel with circuit IR and evidence receipts, pre-registered experimental campaigns on IBM Quantum hardware (Bell baseline; FRONTIER 001-003 causal discrimination of correlation decay; QLAB-002 end-to-end VQE of H2 from a compiled .zeph program, tripartite verification), raw hardware counts, verification scripts, and maturity-labeled reports. Authors: Ravi Dos Anjos (Serena Solutions). AI orchestration (agent Solene, Base44) acknowledged in methodology; all hardware claims point to published job identifiers.
